content.text: Year=2025 covers 2025-12, so the check actually validated the new file.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `8d03b62 2025-12: add rows`.

Before committing I ran `scripts/check.sh`, and it passed. The check only reads files for the year set in `scripts/check.conf`, which is 2025, so the new file was one of the files it checked. All it checks is that every row has as many fields as the header.

The original file is still in `inbox/`, and git doesn't track that folder. Nothing was said about removing it, so I didn't.
